lines.text: [thoughtful] The best teachers don't just talk. They draw... and they stop the second you're lost.
[warmly] Meet CHALK. A voice tutor that teaches on a live whiteboard.
Just ask for any math or physics topic, and it plans the whole lesson, live.
[warmly] Okay! Same speed, level ground, no air drag. Forty-five degrees sends it the farthest. Let's see why.
So, a shallow launch moves fast sideways... but it lands quickly. A steep one stays up longer, but drifts slowly.
Range is just sideways speed times flight time. Multiply them, and you get sine of twice the angle.
Now, sine can never go above one, so twice the angle has to—
[hesitant] Wait, sorry... where did sine of two theta come from?
[warmly] Oh, good question! Look at the range equation. Two sine theta cosine theta... that's the double-angle identity. It's exactly sine of two theta.
So twice the angle is ninety degrees... which makes the launch angle forty-five.
Any topic. Every diagram is generated on the spot, and grounded in what's actually on the board.
Under the hood, a realtime voice model talks and listens. A planner writes the lesson. And a custom drawer orchestrates every stroke, so voice and ink stay in sync.
CHALK. The tutor that draws while it talks... and listens when you need it.
